instrument: single Binance USD-M BTCUSDT linear perpetual; USDT collateral; BitMEX XBTUSD as the price, volume and funding proxy before 2020-01-01
objective: exact per-bar increment of an exponentially weighted Sharpe ratio of net USDT equity log growth, including commission, slippage and funding
algorithm: recurrent PPO with the discrete-action settings of PPO's Atari experiments as CleanRL ppo_atari_lstm runs them: clipped surrogate on GAE advantages normalised per minibatch and recomputed before every pass; fixed entropy bonus; separate LSTM actor and critic with layer normalisation after every hidden layer and recurrent states rebuilt over a burn-in prefix; categorical target position SHORT/FLAT/LONG
budget: 30 passes over each fold's training span, a validated checkpoint every 5; updates, the reward prior and the cost break-even measured per fold

cost_policy: training charges 2 times the 5 bp commission plus 1 bp adverse slippage per leg; evaluation charges the real cost; no curriculum; the extra slippage that would erase the result is reported from turnover
evaluation: each calendar quarter of the validation year from a flat account; the most probable action (argmax), one deterministic path per evaluation; training still samples; IQM with a stratified bootstrap interval and the probability of backtest overfitting across checkpoints
training_episodes: 2176 decisions (90.7 days) each, starting flat, short or long with equal probability, at uniformly random points of the training span; first episodes staggered
